name: test_view_cart_with_multiple_products[chromium]
description:
Test: View cart with multiple added products
    Jira Story: QA-4 - View Cart Contents
    Type: Positive
    
    Preconditions: User is on the website and cart contains multiple products
    
    Steps:
    1. Add multiple products to cart
    2. Click on the cart icon
    3. Verify cart page displays all added products with correct details
